name: Prime exponential sum
pvg_translation: exact reindexing through decoded valuation vectors
claim_ceiling: No cancellation estimate follows from reindexing.

name: Binary representation integral
statement: R_2(N)=int_0^1 S(alpha;N)^2 e(-alpha N) d alpha
pvg_translation: addition-fiber projector integrated over continuous phase
claim_ceiling: Identity alone does not prove positivity.

name: Ternary representation integral
statement: R_3(N)=int_0^1 S(alpha;N)^3 e(-alpha N) d alpha
claim_ceiling: Does not itself prove ternary Goldbach.

name: Major and minor arcs
statement: [0,1)=M union m with rational neighborhoods in M
pvg_translation: phase-space partition over decoded valuation points
claim_ceiling: Partition requires independent estimates on both pieces.

name: Major-arc approximation
statement: Local rational approximations yield main-term data
ant_role: source of singular series and singular integral
claim_ceiling: No asymptotic without uniform approximation and tail control.

name: Minor-arc estimate
statement: Need a norm or pointwise bound making minor arcs smaller than the main term
pvg_translation: cancellation certificate for additive phases on valuation-decoded points
claim_ceiling: Finite cancellation samples do not imply a uniform minor-arc theorem.

name: Singular series
statement: Arithmetic local-density factor assembled from congruence data
ant_role: arithmetic factor in circle-method main terms
claim_ceiling: Formal or truncated products do not prove convergence or positivity.

name: Singular integral
statement: Archimedean scaling factor from the continuous model
pvg_translation: not intrinsic to discrete valuation coordinates
claim_ceiling: PVG reindexing does not generate the Archimedean analysis.

name: Circle-method certificate ladder
statement: exact coefficient identity < major-arc asymptotic < minor-arc domination < positive total main term

name: Integral identity is not Goldbach
statement: R_2(N)=integral identity does not imply R_2(N)>0
pvg_translation: addition-fiber encoding is not existence proof

name: Major arcs alone are insufficient
statement: A positive major-arc model does not prove positivity unless minor arcs are smaller
pvg_translation: local residue compatibility is not global positivity
claim_ceiling: Reject prime-producing claim without minor-arc certificate.

name: Existing circle-method layer
statement: Reuse MNTII-006-H, v0.6-H closure, Addition Fibers, and RMG-005-A
claim_ceiling: No new Goldbach theorem and no RH/GRH progress.
